notes: DeezToken is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with EIP-2612 permit support. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints all 1,000,000,000 DEEZ with 18 decimals once to msg.sender, the factory at launch. It has no owner, transfer fees or subsequent minting. No application contracts are included. pool.initialPrice is provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply.
